preconditions: Select the operation and its actual input, output and shared user-state scope.
Preserve useful original content before replacement; inspect existing state and concurrent writers.
Treat reduction and reuse as hypotheses requiring task-context validation, not execution permission.

expected_effects.effect: prune_content removes selected recognized spans and returns the remaining original text.
expected_effects.scope: Input context, returned text and CLI stdout or --output file.
expected_effects.basis: split_sections resolves overlapping spans in source order; pruning removes rejected spans without rebuilding retained content.
expected_effects.impact: Can reduce context or omit task-critical information; matching and counters do not establish semantic irrelevance.
expected_effects.verification: Compare retained bytes, gaps, nested sections and source order in controlled fixtures; inspect requirements before downstream use.

expected_effects.effect: Multi-section pruning registers sections and updates keep/skip counters, repeatedly rewriting shared state.
expected_effects.scope: User ~/.botte/prefix-tree.json, containing hashes, types, estimated counts and timestamps.
expected_effects.basis: register_section, record_use and record_skip each save; zero/one span returns before registration.
expected_effects.impact: Consumes file I/O and changes later decisions even when no text is removed. Counts describe retention decisions, not observed agent usage.
expected_effects.verification: Patch PREFIX_STORE to a temporary path; compare state before and after kept and rejected cases.

expected_effects.effect: tree/stats read metadata; CLI --output replaces the destination and pruning notices go to stderr.
expected_effects.scope: Shared metadata, output file and output recipients.
expected_effects.basis: CLI handlers load PrefixTree; cmd_prune writes output only when requested.
expected_effects.impact: Reports may reveal usage metadata or context text; file replacement can destroy an original if used as the destination.
expected_effects.verification: Inspect command mode, destinations and stdout/stderr separately in a disposable fixture.

downstream_effects.effect: A consumer may reason from incomplete context or feed earlier pruning choices back into future pruning.
downstream_effects.scope: Later model tasks and the shared retention history.
downstream_effects.basis: Returned text can become a prompt; keep/skip decisions update the same history used for future selection.
downstream_effects.impact: Can propagate missing instructions or reinforce an unvalidated usefulness estimate.
downstream_effects.verification: Compare task correctness and instruction retention with the original context; record omissions and measured costs.

reversibility.strategy: Restore useful original text and prior store contents from preserved copies; reconcile downstream actions separately.
residual_effects: Published or captured prompt content cannot be recalled by this module.
Prior state may be unavailable after replacement; downstream decisions remain.

retry.check_before_retry: Inspect the actual output and shared state after interruption; account for completed writes, changing counters/baselines and concurrent activity.
retry.stop_condition: Resolve repeated persistence failures or uncertain source/state before repeating a write; do not infer task success from reduced output.

required_scope: Existing task authorization for the selected input, shared user-state writes, output destination and recipients. A stored prefix or pruning score grants no permission to change instructions or perform downstream actions.

analysis.summary: The implementation transforms text and records its own choices. It does not measure which sections an agent actually uses; regex spans and character-based token estimates require contextual review.
uncertainties: Shared state is not project-bound; counters may reflect unrelated tasks.
Malformed history may be ignored and later replaced; writes are not atomic or locked.
Semantic necessity and real token savings are not established by scores.

reuse.target: Evaluate context reduction in another agent harness.
reuse.rationale: The transformation accepts explicit text and an injectable tree object.
adaptations: Separate authoritative instructions from pruning candidates.
Use target-scoped state and independently measure task quality and retention.
reuse.validation: Replay representative target tasks with and without pruning; compare required facts, task results, exact retained text and actual token usage.
